[element-article-title]
=== `<article-title>` Article Title (in a citation)

The title of a journal article in the language in which the article was originally published, for use inside citations and <<element-related-article,`<related-article>`>> elements.

#### Attributes

#### Base Attributes

* <<attribute-id,`@id`>>
* <<attribute-xml-base,`@xml:base`>>
* <<attribute-xml-lang,`@xml:lang`>>

#### Tagged Sample

##### In a `<mixed-citation>`
[source,xml]
....
...
<ref id="pr00001">
 <label>(1)</label>
 <mixed-citation>Grosse, A. V., and Conway, J. B., 
  “<article-title>Combustion of Metals in Oxygen</article-title>,” 
  <source>Industrial Engineering Chemistry</source>, Vol50, No.4, April 
  <year iso-8601-date="1958">1958</year>, pp.663–672.</mixed-citation>
</ref>
...
